findings.body: At 80–143 columns with multiple summary rows, a busy or null-command state truncates the entire first line. summary.ts:64 puts the full running test title before its waiting count. With the long title already supplied by pane.test.ts:132, that count starts beyond column 100, so an 80-column strip hides it on both surfaces. The ready state also puts these facts in one truncatable prefix at line 100. New evidence beyond the compact-layout ruling: the protected count boxes only apply when `compact` is populated; the wide summary row remains unprotected. Reserve the required counts and shorten the test title and trailing next-step text within the remaining cells.
